overview_description.description: Huntr is a migrant workforce marketplace recruiting tool. Their services include recruitment, artificial intelligence, disruptive technology, technology companies, human resource technology, HR technology, and artificial intelligence. Huntr deploys AI agents that make labor migration safer, faster, and more transparent for everyone. Huntr is an AI-powered workforce mobility and recruitment technology company focused on simplifying global labor migration and hiring operations. Headquartered in Dubai with operations in the United States, the company develops intelligent AI agents that automate sourcing, matching, document verification, compliance management, onboarding, and workforce tracking for enterprises, recruitment agencies, and governments. Huntr aims to create a transparent, worker-centric ecosystem by providing verified digital identities, interoperable recruitment infrastructure, and data-driven hiring solutions across international labor corridors.
